core_result: Thirteen-state generation, raster transport and NPZ capacity exist; dedicated publication, exact state gates, complete inventory and independent expert selection do not form a complete thirteen-state contract.

findings.title: Two dedicated state products are absent
findings.detail: phenology_progress and stress_memory are absent from the dedicated SIRE state-surface/mode/manifest registry. Phenology still contributes to a composite diagnostic.

findings.title: Five registered state gates are unmapped
findings.detail: LAI, structure, bare soil, thermal stress and surface wetness fail the exact positive-support gate with surface_state_requirement_unmapped.

findings.title: State gates consult different or aggregate support
findings.detail: Canopy water uses vigor; root-zone water accepts canopy-only support; biotic risk uses global BMA/retro proof without an own-state count check. Appropriate diagnostic hypothesis rules still need definition.

findings.title: Missing state support can become Observed
findings.detail: Actual native generator calls with real-raster metadata but no per-state ledger label all eleven states directly_assimilated/Observed. Diagnostic/update denial remains in the fixture. Normal engine outputs ordinarily carry a ledger; no end-to-end action escalation was established.

findings.title: Expected inventory and expert selector are incomplete
findings.detail: The mounted UI has six base lenses and nine overlays; fixed priorities and separate hardcoded inventories do not expose all thirteen latent coordinates independently. Existing expert views and mode-level reasons are retained.

findings.title: Incomplete microzone collections leave zero placeholders
findings.detail: A controlled omitted interior node leaves thirteen zero cells. Complete native fixture has all117 assignments and no holes. Validate completeness or mark unsupported cells nodata while preserving legitimate zero.

findings.title: Stress-memory descriptor and update target disagree
findings.detail: Descriptor declares NOT_ASSIMILATED/NOT_IDENTIFIED/visualization, while stress_memory_index is a registered update target. Reconcile policy; the registry alone does not establish identifiability.

findings.title: No complete thirteen-state GIS publisher in inspected route
findings.detail: Current NPZ retains all thirteen states and canonical surface serialization preserves geospatial/quality metadata. Generic L1 GTiff support exists. A complete ASMAE/SIRE per-state scientific artifact commit/download workflow remains to be defined and connected.

frontend_model.frontend_thirteen_fixture_is: eleven registered state products plus two diagnostics, not thirteen latent states

implementation_recommendation: Begin a bounded F36/T09 support/publication slice using the ordered repair plan. Preserve existing F01 software closures and continue independent F02 work where its prerequisites exist. No production repair is implemented by this review.
